# AWS Cost and Usage Reports

Store legacy CUR report definitions and tags as account-wide records without generating billing data or report files.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `costandusagereportservice` |
| Signing name | `cur` |
| Wire protocol | AWS JSON 1.1 |
| API version | `2017-01-06` |
| Scope | Account-wide |
| Execution | Records only |
| Selected operations | 7 of 7 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#aws-cost-and-usage-reports) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- Records only: no AWS bills, cost calculations, cost fixtures, report files, manifests, S3 writes, Athena/Redshift/QuickSight integrations or delivery status.
- S3 destination existence, ownership and delivery permissions are not validated; AWS documents destination validation separately and ownership checks at delivery.
- BillingViewArn and ReportStatus inputs explicitly return ValidationException; Billing Conductor views and report delivery are not implemented.
- No report-count quota is enforced; only modeled input constraints and the shared tag limit are enforced.
- No CloudFormation handler for AWS::CUR::ReportDefinition; CDK and awscc deployment are unsupported.
- CUR 2.0 and BCM Data Exports are not implemented.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
